events.title: US-Japan Coordinated Yen Intervention — First Since 1998
events.description: US Treasury and Japan MOF conducted rare coordinated yen-buying intervention. First joint US-Japan FX intervention since 1998. Treasury Sec Bessent's notepad read 'To Do Buy Japanese Yen $5-10 bil'. NY Fed sold euros to buy yen. Japan and US confirmed intervention on Aug 3, standing ready to act again. 2-year JGB yield hit 1.545% — highest since 1995.

events.title: Iran War — Strait of Hormuz Crisis, Fresh Tanker Strike, Ceasefire Stalemate
events.description: Active US-Iran war (Day 157+). NEW: Cargo ship hit by projectile overnight (Aug 3-4) off Oman in Strait of Hormuz. Iran denies talks with US, Trump calls leadership 'unbelievably duplicitous'. Iran discussing safe route through Hormuz with Oman. Israel strikes killed 26 in Gaza over weekend. Hormuz disruptions caused Brent to jump 10-13% earlier, now retreating to $82.92 as MOU signed June 18.

events.title: Ebola Epidemic PHEIC — 3,532 Cases, 1,707 Deaths, Fastest-Growing Outbreak
events.description: WHO PHEIC declared May 16, 2026. UPDATE: Now 3,532+ confirmed cases and 1,707 deaths across 49 health zones in 5 provinces of DRC. 44% case-fatality rate. Uganda discharged last Ebola patient. Bundibugyo virus strain. AP reports this is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record.

events.title: Gold at $4,060/oz — Safe Haven Panic Above $3,500 RED Threshold
events.description: Gold trading near $4,060/oz, well above $3,500 RED threshold. Driven by US-Iran war, yen intervention, sovereign debt concerns. Analysts expect range $3,580-$4,645 for August. JP Morgan forecast $4,000 by mid-2026 — already exceeded.

events.title: Japan-South Korea-US Trilateral FX Intervention — Unprecedented
events.description: South Korea joined Japan and US in unprecedented joint FX intervention. Won hit 9-month high. First trilateral coordinated currency intervention. BOJ held rates at 1% (8-1 vote, Takata dissenting for 1.25%). BOJ warned core inflation exceeding 2% target. JGB yields at 2.85% (above 2.5% threshold). 2-year JGB hit 1.545% — highest since 1995.

events.title: OPEC+ Production Quota Increase — 188,000 bpd for September
events.description: OPEC+ (7 members) agreed Aug 2 to boost production quota by 188,000 bpd for September. Brent fell 5.69% to $82.92/bbl as of Aug 3. Continuing unwind of 2023 voluntary cuts. EIA forecasting $74/b average. Members cannot fill existing quotas. WTI August range $67.93-$106.74.

additional_findings.title: FOMC Held Rates at 3.50%-3.75% (9-3 Vote) — August 3
additional_findings.description: FOMC maintained target range at 3.50%-3.75% on Aug 3, 2026. 9-3 vote suggests internal disagreement. Routine decision, not emergency.

additional_findings.title: ECB Climate Risk Warning + Financial Statements Published
additional_findings.description: ECB official Frank Elderson warned climate crisis poses growing threat to core financial stability. ECB published consolidated financial statement as at July 31, 2026. No emergency actions.

additional_findings.title: BOE Held at 3.75%, Gilt Yields Volatile Over £24bn Treasury Gap
additional_findings.description: BOE held rates at 3.75%. Gilt yields volatile as traders anxious over £24 billion Treasury gap and debt issuance. Sterling slipping toward 1.3500. BOE flagged Iran war as inflation risk.

additional_findings.title: Argentina Third Credit Upgrade (Moody's), Brazil Copom This Week
additional_findings.description: Argentina won third credit upgrade in 3 months (Moody's lifted rating). BCRA met $10.1bn dollar accumulation goal. IMF principal payments due from September (~$3bn remainder 2026). Brazil Copom rate decision this week.

additional_findings.title: South Africa-Nigeria Diplomatic Crisis, Ethiopia TPLF Resurgence
additional_findings.description: Anti-migrant violence fallout: South Africa deportations topping 109,000. Ghana cancelled Ramaphosa visit. Nigeria-Ghana diplomatic tension escalating. Ethiopia TPLF conflict resurgence. Sahel jihadist insurgency.

additional_findings.title: PBOC Pledges Moderately Loose Policy for H2 2026
additional_findings.description: PBOC vowed timely policy tool adjustment, facilitating panda bond issuance. Moderately loose monetary policy continuing. Focus on stabilizing property, local debt risks, banking reform.

additional_findings.title: No New Systemic Stress Events Detected
additional_findings.description: No bank failures, credit freezes, or systemic risk events detected in this scan window. Russia Sberbank credit deterioration (previously noted) remains a background risk.

additional_findings.title: COVID-19 Growing in 41 US States (Background)
additional_findings.description: CDC estimates COVID-19 infections growing or likely growing in 41 states as of July 29. Not category-5 but monitoring.

Global risk environment remains CRITICAL.
